task.goal: Resolve the public DOI to an exact PMID, then return only raw PubMed Comments/Corrections relation fields when PMID is returned.
task.source_quality: Same fixed NCBI/PMC providers and identical DOI/PMID for both execution paths.

Raw Comments/Corrections relation fields returned for exact PubMed records at retrieval time only; no completeness claim is made and an empty relation list does not prove that no correction, expression of concern, or retraction exists.

One DOI-to-PMID resolution response followed, only when an exact PMID is returned, by raw PubMed Comments/Corrections fields for that exact record. comparison.identifier_response_hash_interpretation: The mapped DOI/PMID/PMCID/status fields agree, but the provider response digest changed across the two calls; these are separate live responses, not byte-identical evidence.

interpretation: One matched live task compares a manual resolver-plus-reader sequence with the composed route. The normalized DOI/PMID/PMCID/status fields match after excluding per-run timestamps and response digests; the resolver response hashes differ across calls, while the exact PubMed reader response hash matches. The initial 0.1.0 resolver result omitted an integer PMID; a raw response-shape probe identified the integer and version 0.1.1 now normalizes it. Process times are one-run observations, not a benchmark or cost estimate; no completeness or absence claim follows from an empty relation list.

fixed_result.normalization: positive bounded JSON integer to decimal string; previous decimal-string input remains accepted

c1_disposition.compared_same_task: one DOI executed as the manual resolver plus exact-PMID reader and through the composed DOI tool
findings: Both paths returned DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0005403 -> PMID 19404397 and PMCID PMC2671458. The separate update-reader stage returned the same exact record status and response hash in both paths: RECORD_FOUND_NO_RECORDED_RELATIONS.

The resolver stage's mapped identity/status fields matched after removing retrieval timestamps and response hashes; its response hashes differed across live calls, so the raw provider responses were not byte-identical.
The composed route adds one-DOI task entry and explicit stage receipt; it uses the same two pinned adapters and does not replace either one's independently useful DOI-only or exact-PMID-only task.
limits: One matched task does not establish broad accuracy, coverage, service reliability, cost, maintainability, or a general speed advantage.
Single-run process wall and child-CPU observations are not a benchmark; billed cost and bandwidth remain UNKNOWN.
An empty Comments/Corrections list is only what this PubMed response returned and does not prove that no update exists.
c1_disposition.retirement_decision: Retain the two source adapters and the optional composition with narrowed task scopes; no retirement or replacement is supported.
